name: admin-shell
title: Admin shell
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Collapsible shadcn sidebar, breadcrumbs from one nav config, a command palette, and a theme toggle that uses the host controller when you pass one.

meta.descriptionEs: Barra lateral que se pliega a iconos, migas de pan, paleta de comandos y tema. Los enlaces los pone el anfitrión.

examples.title: Estudio Acme
examples.description: Tres pantallas en memoria. Cmd+K busca. El tema cicla claro, oscuro y sistema.

api.name: groups
api.description: Sidebar groups. Each item has href, label, and a lucide icon.

api.name: pathname / onNavigate
api.description: The host owns the route. No next/link import.

api.name: themeController
api.description: Pass next-themes useTheme(). Without it, the shell toggles the dark class.

api.name: actions
api.description: Slot in the top bar, before the theme button.

api.name: breadcrumbsFor
api.description: Crumbs derived from the same nav config.

api.name: navStyle="pill"
api.description: Pill navigation and a count on each item. The default row style is unchanged.

docs: Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, breadcrumb, command, or sidebar. Pass themeController from next-themes so the shell does not fight the host provider.
